facts.text: First-year cadets, called knobs, participate in the Fourth Class System, a nine-month freshman military training period.

sources.title: From Matriculation to Graduation: The Citadel Corps Journey
sources.quote: First-year cadets, known as “knobs,” who follow a prescribed training system called the Fourth Class System, which is unique among other senior military colleges as The Citadel's Fourth Class System is the only freshman training period lasting a full nine months.
